    A Krull–Schmidt step #

    A nonzero indecomposable split summand of a direct sum of indecomposables is isomorphic to one of the summands (iso_summand_of_splitMono). Consequently the source of an irreducible map into a nonzero indecomposable Z is isomorphic to a summand of the chosen minimal right almost split map into Z (IsIrr.iso_chosenMin), so irreducible predecessors are predecessors in PredC.
